open_points.subject: read_import_mapping
open_points.text: read_import_mapping: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] Each refused pick or Customer value MUST carry as its path the name of the field of = models.ImportChoices that holds its list followed by its position in that list counted from zero, and nothing else; the failures MUST be ordered by kind in the member order of = models.RefusalKind, so that every failure of the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member of = models.RefusalKind comes before every failure of the DUPLICATE_PICK member of = models.RefusalKind, and within one kind by path, names compared by Unicode code point and positions as numbers.
open_points.other_text: RefusalKind enum members: ACTIVE='active', AGENT_CALL_REFUSED='agent_call_refused', ANONYMISED='anonymised', ANSWER_ABOVE_CLASS='answer_above_class', ARCHIVED='archived', CONFIRMATION_BOUND_ELSEWHERE='confirmation_bound_elsewhere', CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED='confirmation_expired', CONFIRMATION_NOT_PENDING='confirmation_not_pending', CONFIRMATION_OTHER_VALUE='confirmation_other_value', CONFLICT='conflict', CSRF_REFUSED='csrf_refused', CUSTOMER_ENDED='customer_ended', CUSTOMER_ERASED='customer_erased', CUSTOMER_RESTRICTED='customer_restricted', DATE_AFTER_TODAY='date_after_today', DUPLICATE_PICK='duplicate_pick', ERASED='erased', FILE_MALFORMED='file_malformed', FILE_NOT_KEPT='file_not_kept', FILE_TOO_LARGE='file_too_large', FILE_UNREADABLE='file_unreadable', IMPORT_CLOSED='import_closed', MALFORMED_REQUEST_ID='malformed_request_id', MAPPING_NOT_CLEAN='mapping_not_clean', MISSING_VALUE='missing_value', NOT_GRANTED='not_granted', NOT_PENDING='not_pending', NO_OWNER_SESSION='no_owner_session', NO_PICKS='no_picks', NO_VALID_TOKEN='no_valid_token', OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST='outside_closed_list', OUTSIDE_FORM='outside_form', OUTSIDE_SERVICE_RIGHTS='outside_service_rights', SIGN_IN_REFUSED='sign_in_refused', STALE_ACCESS_VERSION='stale_access_version', STALE_REVISION='stale_revision', SUPERSEDED='superseded', TRANSACTION_FAILED='transaction_failed', UNKNOWN_ARTIFACT_TYPE='unknown_artifact_type', UNKNOWN_CUSTOMER='unknown_customer', UNKNOWN_POINTER='unknown_pointer', UNKNOWN_PROJECT='unknown_project', UNKNOWN_ROOM='unknown_room', UNKNOWN_SESSION='unknown_session', WITHDRAWN='withdrawn'
open_points.question: Must failures follow the declared RefusalKind member order, which places DUPLICATE_PICK before OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST, or must OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST failures come first?

open_points.subject: _build_mapping
open_points.text: _build_mapping: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST pass every given alias as the ALIAS member of = models.FormField and every given Customer kind as the CUSTOMER_KIND member of = models.FormField through check_value_forms, each with a path naming its subject, and MUST make one MappingFormFailure for each failure it answers, with the subject of the value, as its field the member of = models.MappingField of the same name as the member of = models.FormField the value was passed as, and the kind check_value_forms answered.
open_points.rule: Таблица — это когда по члену перечисления выбирается значение: член другого перечисления, код, категория. Такое соответствие — само значение, таблица соответствий, даже когда оно сводится к «один член — одно, остальные — другое»; подмножество членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.
open_points.question: The FormField-to-MappingField correspondence must become an imported provider-data constant named by the note, rather than a same-name mapping defined in prose.
